scope: Bounded T1-only resolution audit. No new model fitting, tuning or physical acquisition.
models: Reuse all five saved round46 coupled-state coefficient sets unchanged. Reconstruct the same recorded-input 16-second training span from the same observed initial state. Model spread is descriptive sensitivity, not an independent confidence interval.
fastData: Keep the two 200-sample windows separate. Group each into ten complete 20-sample intervals. Compare commands within each interval and encoder position against the nominal-index chord between its observed slow endpoints. Chord departures describe actual captured within-interval variation, not measurement noise or an unseen trajectory error bound.
coverage: Report observed fast samples relative to all core intervals and phase2/4 intervals. Do not extrapolate the two windows to the full run.
initialQuantization: No statistical sensor accuracy assumption or invented carriage measurement tolerance.
effectIllustrationMeaning: Divide worst prior internal held-block sync reconstruction RMSE by illustrative effects, not acceptance requirements, causal treatment effects or prediction guarantees.
tests: Known coupled-model roundtrip; exact full-fit reconstruction; all fast/slow shared endpoints; constant/linear chord fixtures; raw and predecessor hashes before and after.
stopRule: No model expansion. If independent accuracy and one-millisecond compatibility remain unestablished, keep controller screening, V1 and formal acquisition unreleased. No automatic extra capture.
